profile.headline: Engineer and Software Developer
profile.summary:
A highly skilled Electrical and Software Engineer with exceptional technical expertise and a proven ability to transform client concepts into revenue enhancing reality.

Effectively combine creative and technical talents to communicate with clients to conceptualize business requirements and deliver quality software / engineering solutions.

Reputation for dedicated teamwork, high-energy work ethic and a commitment to client satisfaction.

Accomplished software developer with over fifteen years experience in the Software Engineering and programming industry.

Skills: Visual Basic, .NET Technologies, ASP, JAVA, XML, Android Development Eclipse, SDK, ADP, API, SQL, SharePoint, DB Administration, ETL Development, Project Management, Process Improvement, Scrum, Agile, WordPress, Custom Report Development, Third Party Data Transfers/Imports/Exports.

positions.title: Information Technology Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · .NET Framework · GPS Tracking · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · AngularJS · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · Software Design · Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Engineering

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Main role is a custom application/web/database developer and technical support of designed and 3rd party software. 

Design and develop custom application, database and reporting solutions per internal client needs.  Key skills used Power BI, VB, .NET, ASP, JAVA, perl, Python, XML, HTML 5, SQL, Access, Excel, SharePoint, Crystal Reports, ETL Development, Android Development Eclipse, Android Studio, SDK, ADP, API.

Create custom reporting solutions using SQL queries and sub queries and .NET - PIVOTS, JOINS, CURSORS, SSIS solutions and Grid objects.

Responsible for the development and internal management of web based patient care application.  Application allows physician, nurses, patients and their families to access and update patient information online.

Developed .Net custom application for the company payroll process.  Application designed to accept import files from numerous third party systems, allows payroll department to react to custom data alerts, edit data and create export files for pay. 

Developed email based time sheet summaries with attestations for employees to sign weekly.

Responsible for creating XML manifest and data files for the ACA Tax filing upload process annually.

Design and develop applications for all android tablets used by field staff for patient care using Android Studio, Eclipse and Android Platform Tools.

Developed and managed e-learning project which will allow employees to take training courses online and track and capture progress and result for users.

Developed and managed ASP based GPS tracking system to help management pay calculated mileage versus reported mileage based on longitude and latitude calculations.

Developed an online complaints and incidents system in .NET that incorporates form creations dynamically and reports dynamically using PIVOTS.

Developed a VB and ASP .NET performance review and evaluation system that allows management to conduct annual performance reviews online and determine annual pay increases.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Research Collaboration · Internet Information Services (IIS) · Microsoft Power BI

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Retained by diverse industry clients to design and develop custom software to enable their business to accomplish internal goals and perform specialty functions and procedures.

Designed and developed custom application and database solutions per client requirements.

Work closely with company executives to conceptualize, design and launch Internet/intranet sites and e-commerce initiatives to further company goals.

Developed a commercial grade software package that was written in Visual Basic and using SQL 2000.  Main functionality allows users to automate specialty business functions that are currently accomplished using hand-based methods.

positions.title: 3m Germany
positions.description:
Designed and developed commercially targeted software to convert stand – alone machinery into networked data providers.

Developed shop floor automation software applications that provided PLC and PC communications using Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) and Suite link.

Developed test cases, performed unit and user testing on system and wrote help manuals.

positions.title: Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and developed a custom quality testing system that will be utilized by all plants to have real-time data regarding all products to know at anytime if good product is being made.

Designed and developed a full-scale MS SQL network database system.

Responsible for hardware and PLC connectivity configuration and HMI interfacing.

Developed test cases, performed unit and user testing on system and wrote help manuals.

positions.title: Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and developed a custom client/server Data Management Systems designed for laboratory use that met FDA quality guidelines.

Interfaced new custom software with existing hardware to eliminate user input.

Designed and developed MS SQL database and utilized ETL and transformation protocols to load historical VAX and AS400 data into new system.

Designed and developed a canned and ad-hoc reporting system using Crystal Reports.

Developed test cases, performed unit and user testing on system and wrote help manuals.
